title: Fix the Grade Boundaries
description: The program should assign letter grades: 90+ is A, 80+ is B, otherwise C.
expectedBehavior: A score of 95 should be graded 'A'.
actualProblem: Because the looser condition score >= 80 is checked first, a 95 satisfies it immediately and is graded 'B' — the score >= 90 branch is never reached for any score of 90 or above.
explanation: An if/else if chain stops at the first true condition, evaluated top to bottom. Range checks must be ordered from most restrictive (highest threshold) to least restrictive.
